_meta.description: OXRS-ready custom icons for the tile types in TILE_CATALOG_MAPPING.md. Send each one to a panel with {"addIcon": {"name": <name>, "imageBase64": <imageBase64>}} on cmnd/<client-id>. Icons are not persistent on the panel and must be resent after every restart.
_meta.render: 60x60 px, white on transparent, PNG RGBA

firmwareLimits.nameRule: must not start with '_' (reserved for firmware built-ins)
